name: a_earnings_next
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Friday October 16, 2026. Topic: Earnings tonight & tomorrow.

Window: Thursday October 15, 2026 4:00 PM ET (after the close) through Friday October 16, 2026 02:03 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. Anything published after 02:03 ET on Friday October 16, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Companies reporting after the close on the brief date or before the open on the next session: EPS and revenue consensus, year-ago figures, options-implied move, and analyst previews (firm, rating, PT).

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **MTB** — Banking
- M&T Bank was scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the open on Friday, October 16; one consensus set estimated EPS at **$4.93** and revenue at **$2.53 billion**, versus second-quarter EPS of **$5.35** and revenue of **$2.53 billion**. (Investing.com, Oct 15; updated Oct 16, publication time not shown)[1]
- A separate estimate listed consensus EPS at **$4.98**, representing a **2.26%** increase from the year-ago quarter. (Nasdaq/Zacks, Oct 15, publication time not shown)[5]
- Another earnings estimate listed EPS of **$4.93** and revenue of **$2.53 billion** for the quarter. (Newsquawk, Oct 15, publication time not shown)[8]
- Consensus analyst rating was **Hold**, with an average price target of **$248.79**; the referenced share price was **$216.05**. (Investing.com, Oct 15; updated Oct 16, publication time not shown)[1]

## **TRV** — Insurance
- The Travelers Companies was scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the open on Friday, October 16, with consensus EPS of **$7.01**, a **13.88% decrease** from the year-ago quarter. (Nasdaq/Zacks, Oct 15, publication time not shown)[5]

## **TFC** — Banking
- Truist Financial was scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the open on Friday, October 16, with consensus EPS of **$1.17**, a **12.50% increase** from the year-ago quarter. (Nasdaq/Zacks, Oct 15, publication time not shown)[5]
- A separate estimate put expected GAAP EPS at **$1.13** and the three-month average analyst price target at **$54.91**, with a high target of **$61** and a low target of **$50**. (Business Insider, Oct 15; updated Oct 16, publication time not shown)[9]

## **CFG** — Banking
- Citizens Financial Group was scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the open on Friday, October 16, with consensus EPS of **$1.38**, a **31.43% increase** from the year-ago quarter. (Nasdaq/Zacks, Oct 15, publication time not shown)[5]
- A separate estimate put expected adjusted EPS at **$1.40** and the three-month average analyst price target at **$79.61**, with a high target of **$90** and a low target of **$70**. (Business Insider, Oct 15; updated Oct 16, publication time not shown)[9]

## **RF** — Banking
- Regions Financial was scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the open on Friday, October 16, with consensus EPS of **$0.67**, a **6.35% increase** from the year-ago quarter. (Nasdaq/Zacks, Oct 15, publication time not shown)[5]
- Another estimate listed consensus EPS at **$0.66** and revenue at **$1.99 billion**. (Newsquawk, Oct 15, publication time not shown)[8]

## **ERIC** — Communications & Networking
- Ericsson reported third-quarter revenue of **$6.168 billion**, versus consensus of **$5.790 billion** and year-ago revenue of **$5.910 billion**. (ScanX, Oct 15 11:24 ET; updated Oct 16 00:08 ET)[7]
- Ericsson reported EPS of **$0.18**, versus consensus of **$0.14** and year-ago EPS of **$0.35**. (ScanX, Oct 15 11:24 ET; updated Oct 16 00:08 ET)[7]
- The analyst consensus rating was **Hold**, with an average price target of **$9.60**; cited prior actions were JPMorgan lowering its target to **$10.20** on October 8 and Morgan Stanley downgrading Ericsson to **Underweight** with a **$9** target on September 22. (ScanX, Oct 15 11:24 ET; updated Oct 16 00:08 ET)[7]
- Ericsson announced a global restructuring creating a unified **Market Area Asia-Pacific** organization on October 15, 2026. (ScanX, Oct 15 11:24 ET; updated Oct 16 00:08 ET)[7]

## **WFC** — Banking
- Wells Fargo reported EPS of **$1.87**, versus consensus of **$1.85**, and revenue of **$21.87 billion**, versus consensus of **$22.15 billion**. (Zacks/Yahoo Finance, Oct 15, publication time not shown)[10]

## **TSM** — Semiconductors
- Taiwan Semiconductor reported third-quarter 2026 ADR EPS of **$4.60**, up **68.7% year over year**, and revenue of **$46.72 billion**, up **41.2% year over year**. (Zacks/Yahoo Finance, Oct 15, publication time not shown)[6]
- TSMC’s third-quarter EPS was **TWD 29.43**, and reported ROE was **45.5%**. (Zacks/Yahoo Finance, Oct 15, publication time not shown)[6]
